coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the bedroom light off and the air conditioner on low for restless, anxious nights
Wake up, wash face, brush teeth, and take morning chronic-condition medication with a glass of water
Get dressed in work clothes, check phone for one-on-one messages from relatives, and set out the day's planner
Make a simple breakfast with the kettle and toaster, eat standing at the counter, and pack a lunch and snacks into a bag
Walk the dog around the block on a short familiar route, keeping to well-lit streets
Feed the dog, refill its water bowl, and rinse the breakfast dishes
Do the school run and drop-off, walking the child to the school gate before the shift begins
Gather work bag, printouts, and medication, then double-check appointment notes and transit timings on the phone
Take the public transit commute to the clinic, reading appointment lists and answering one-on-one texts on the way
Arrive at the clinic, log in to the booking system, and set up the consultation room
Work the morning clinic block, seeing community health appointments and recording detailed case notes
Take a lunch break, eating the packed lunch and sending a few brief one-on-one check-in texts
Carry out primary education aide duties at the school, supporting small reading and health-literacy groups
Take a short tea break, sit quietly, and reply to messages from neighbours about upcoming community visits
Finish the shift with community outreach visits and follow-up paperwork on referrals and medication checks
Take the public transit commute home, decompressing with music and a one-on-one text thread
Greet the dog, start dinner preparation using the induction cooker and refrigerator ingredients
Eat the family dinner at the table and talk through the day calmly
Sit at the computer to review school paperwork, homework schedules, and clinic admin notes
Relax on the sofa with the dog, watching light television under the air conditioner
Send detailed one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbours and confirm tomorrow's errands
Take a warm shower with the water heater and run the dehumidifier and fan
Prepare tomorrow's lunch, tidy the counter, and take evening chronic-condition medication
Wind down in bed with the desk lamp on, reading a few pages and setting an alarm and reminders
Sleep, with the light off and the air conditioner set for a calm night
